overview: The Medford Housing Authority board reviewed quarterly financials, received operational and modernization updates from the executive director, and approved policy resolutions regarding reasonable accommodations, admissions, and voucher fair market rents.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The board approved the minutes from the July 13, 2022 meeting, the July 13 executive session, and the July 20 special meeting.

items.title: Financial Report
items.summary: The board approved the financial report covering the first nine months of the fiscal year.

items.title: Executive Director Report
items.summary: Executive Director Jeffrey Driscoll reported on staff hires, Saltonstall resident relocations, expansion of the Family Self-Sufficiency program, voucher numbers, and prospective long-term redevelopment planning.

items.title: Resolution 2022-041: Reasonable Accommodation Policy
items.summary: The board approved the housing authority's Reasonable Accommodation Policy incorporating required Department of Housing and Community Development language.

items.title: Resolution 2022-042: Admission and Continued Occupancy Policy Revisions
items.summary: The board approved revisions to the Admission and Continued Occupancy Policy regarding household composition and transfer procedures.

items.title: Resolution 2022-043: Small Area Fair Market Rents
items.summary: The board approved adopting Small Area Fair Market Rents to adjust Section 8 voucher payment limits across zip codes.

items.title: Community Preservation Committee Funding Application
items.summary: Driscoll updated the board on an eligibility submission requesting $2.4 million over three years from the Community Preservation Committee for Walkling Court.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: The board voted to enter executive session to discuss security matters without returning to open session.
